entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this useless VeloBand tracker. I've had it for a few weeks and I'm done with it. I want my money back, now.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It doesn't matter what the issue is! I don't like it. Your website says I can return it. I bought it on December 15th. Process the refund.

I understand your frustration, sir. Let me pull up your order. While our general policy has been updated for wearable devices due to hygiene and sanitation reasons, I need to check the specifics for your model.

What are you talking about, 'hygiene'? I'm looking at your return policy right now online and it says 90 days! Are you trying to scam me? This is unbelievable! I want to speak to a manager immediately.

Sir, there's no need for that, I assure you I can resolve this. The stricter rules are for our newer medical-grade devices. Let me just take one moment to review the policy tied to the VeloBand GPS Tracker specifically. Please hold.
You better. Because if you tell me it's too late, I'm going to light up your company on every review site on the internet.

Thank you for your patience. I've confirmed the details, and you are absolutely correct. My sincere apologies for the confusion. The VeloBand GPS Tracker is covered by our 90-day return policy. Since you're at day 27, you are well within the window for a full refund.
Right. I told you so. So, are you processing it or not?

Yes, of course. I have just initiated the return for you. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just package the band in its original box and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be credited back to your original payment method.
I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
